Seconds before the 5-minute buyer forum slot opens that review.py may queue the next post (the kit holds it on 429 and sends it within 10 s of the slot). Larger: fewer missed slots when deals are sparse, more 429 retries; smaller: the reverse.
Restock score multiplier for catalog SKUs that settled in the market in the last 6 h while we hold 0 units (unserved demand). 1.0 = today's behaviour; the range stops at double the default.
Seconds the buyer waits before its single retry of a shop quote after a read timeout, connection error or 5xx; longer gives a slow shop more time, shorter keeps the order moving.
